notes.title: Paperverse Direct and Demo!
notes.content:
Hey, y’all!

We are excited to announce that we teamed up with Paperverse to be included in their direct! This direct also includes a link to a free demo disk featuring a ton of great Paper Mario-inspired games, including Flightless!

Check out the full direct and get the demo disk here? [url=https://youtu.be/bvCnUyAhkvI]Here's the YouTube link![/url]

🔴 Be sure to Wishlist us and all the other awesome games you like from the direct if you haven't already please!

Anywho, have a gnarly day!
- Andy

notes.title: Ready to build confidence and eat oats?
notes.content:
Hey, y’all!

I’m Andrew from Mole Team 6. My team and I are extremely excited to be here on Steam and finally show you more of what we’ve been up to!

The game is far from being finished, so expect us to spill the beans for y’all on the game’s mechanics and behind-the-scenes looks at the development! Feedback is always appreciated and encouraged, we love to hear from fans!😄

By the way... have ya checked out our gnarly reveal trailer? Looks like some devious characters corrupted the beginning and end, I wonder why?🤔
[url=https://youtu.be/jOq1togfJ9o]Here's the youtube link![/url]


🔴 Be sure to wishlist if you haven't already please!

Anywho, let us know what you think, and I hope you have a tubular day!
- Andrew
